crossRefs.note: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him…
He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it…
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: She said to them, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,
translations.bsb: And Huldah said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Tell the man who sent you
translations.kjv: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,
translations.asv: And she said unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Tell ye the man that sent you unto me,
